classes.name: hello-glow-content
classes.rule: position: relative; z-index: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 100%; height: 100%;

classes.name: hello-glow-overlay
classes.rule: position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 12; border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; animation: hello-glow-lifetime 3s ease forwards;

classes.name: hidden
classes.rule: display: none;

classes.name: icon-label
classes.rule: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0;

classes.name: image-card
classes.rule: position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; min-height: 210px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--surface-strong)); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 hsl(var(--foreground) / 0.03); width: 100%;

classes.name: image-card-overlay
classes.rule: position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; left: 8px; display: grid; gap: 2px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--background) / 0.92); padding: 8px; backdrop-filter: blur(14px);

classes.name: image-card-source
classes.rule: min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;

classes.name: image-card-title
classes.rule: color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 760;

classes.name: insights-overview
classes.rule: grid-column: 1 / -1;

classes.name: insights-panel
classes.rule: display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 0.8fr) minmax(280px, 1.2fr); gap: 12px;

classes.name: insights-section
classes.rule: display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 10px; min-width: 0;

classes.name: insights-title
classes.rule: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 800;

classes.name: is-active
classes.rule: border-color: hsl(var(--foreground)); background: hsl(var(--foreground)); color: hsl(var(--background));

classes.name: is-open
classes.rule: z-index: 140;

classes.name: is-visible
classes.rule: max-width: 140px;

classes.name: media-source
classes.rule: position: absolute; right: 8px; bottom: 8px; max-width: calc(100% - 16px); overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 999px; background: hsl(var(--background) / 0.9); color: hsl(var(--foreground)); padding: 4px 7px; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 760; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;

classes.name: music-art
classes.rule: position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--surface-strong));

classes.name: music-card
classes.rule: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 14px; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--card)); padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 hsl(var(--foreground) / 0.03); width: 100%; overflow: hidden;

classes.name: music-desc
classes.rule: min-width: 0; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.55; overflow: hidden; overflow-wrap: anywhere; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 6;

classes.name: music-info
classes.rule: display: grid; align-content: start; gap: 8px; min-width: 0;

classes.name: music-title
classes.rule: color: hsl(var(--foreground)); font-weight: 780; line-height: 1.35; overflow-wrap: anywhere; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; overflow: hidden;

classes.name: news-card
classes.rule: grid-template-columns: 1fr;

classes.name: news-thumb
classes.rule: aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; width: 100%;

classes.name: placeholder-media
classes.rule: width: 100%; height: 100%; min-height: 0; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 8px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(var(--surface-strong)), hsl(var(--surface))), hsl(var(--surface-strong));

classes.name: play-overlay
classes.rule: position: absolute; z-index: 1; right: 10px; bottom: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 34px; height: 34px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 999px; background: hsl(var(--background) / 0.9); backdrop-filter: blur(12px);

classes.name: primary-action
classes.rule: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 42px; border-color: hsl(var(--primary)); background: hsl(var(--primary)); color: hsl(var(--primary-foreground)); padding: 0 16px; font-weight: 780; white-space: nowrap;

classes.name: result-card
classes.rule: display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 12px; align-items: start; min-width: 0; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 10px; background: hsl(var(--card)); padding: 12px; box-shadow: 0 1px 0 hsl(var(--foreground) / 0.03); width: 100%; overflow: hidden;

classes.name: result-content
classes.rule: display: grid; gap: 8px; min-width: 0;

classes.name: result-list
classes.rule: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(min(100%, 360px), 1fr)); grid-auto-flow: dense; grid-auto-rows: 8px; gap: 10px; align-items: start;

classes.name: result-media
classes.rule: position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border-bottom: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); background: hsl(var(--surface-strong));

classes.name: result-snippet
classes.rule: min-width: 0; color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 0.96rem; line-height: 1.6; overflow: hidden; overflow-wrap: anywhere; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 4;

classes.name: result-tags
classes.rule: display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px;

classes.name: results-main
classes.rule: min-width: 0;

classes.name: results-shell
classes.rule: display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); width: min(100%, 1540px); margin: 0 auto; padding: 18px clamp(14px, 3vw, 32px) 32px;

classes.name: results-status
classes.rule: color: hsl(var(--muted-foreground)); font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.5;

classes.name: search-form
classes.rule: display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(220px, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; min-width: 0;

classes.name: segmented-select
classes.rule: display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; min-width: 0;

classes.name: site-header
classes.rule: display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(260px, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 20px; background: hsl(var(--background) / 0.94); padding: 12px clamp(14px, 3vw, 32px); backdrop-filter: blur(18px); overflow: hidden;

classes.name: site-shell
classes.rule: --background: 0 0% 100%; --foreground: 0 0% 4%; --surface: 0 0% 98%; --surface-strong: 0 0% 94%; --muted: 0 0% 91%; --muted-foreground: 0 0% 39%; --border: 0 0% 88%; --card: 0 0% 100%; --accent: 0 0% 4%; --accent-foreground: 0 0% 98%; --success: 0 0% 18%; --success-text: 0 0% 14%; --danger: 0 72% 42%; --primary: 0 0% 4%; --primary-foreground: 0 0% 98%; --ring: 0 0% 4%; min-height: 100vh; background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground));

classes.name: sticky-headers
classes.rule: position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 30;

classes.name: text-field
classes.rule: display: grid; gap: 6px; min-width: 0;

classes.name: theme-dark
classes.rule: background: hsl(var(--background)); color: hsl(var(--foreground));

classes.name: theme-light
classes.rule: color-scheme: light; --background: 0 0% 100%; --foreground: 0 0% 4%; --surface: 0 0% 98%; --surface-strong: 0 0% 94%; --muted: 0 0% 91%; --muted-foreground: 0 0% 39%; --border: 0 0% 88%; --card: 0 0% 100%; --accent: 0 0% 4%; --accent-foreground: 0 0% 98%; --primary: 0 0% 4%; --primary-foreground: 0 0% 98%; --ring: 0 0% 4%; --success: 0 0% 18%; --success-text: 0 0% 14%; --danger: 0 72% 42%; --warning-text: 35 92% 32%;

classes.name: ui-collapse
classes.rule: display: grid; min-width: 0;

classes.name: ui-collapse-content
classes.rule: display: grid; gap: 12px; min-width: 0;

classes.name: ui-collapse-trigger
classes.rule: border: 1px solid hsl(var(--border)); border-radius: 8px; background: hsl(var(--card)); color: hsl(var(--foreground));

classes.name: ui-icon
classes.rule: flex: 0 0 auto; width: 16px; height: 16px; color: currentColor; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.8;

classes.name: video-card
classes.rule: grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 10px; align-content: start; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; padding: 8px; box-shadow: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease, transform 160ms ease;

classes.name: video-desc
classes.rule: font-size: 0.84rem; line-height: 1.45; -webkit-line-clamp: 2;

classes.name: video-info
classes.rule: gap: 6px; padding: 0 2px;

classes.name: video-meta
classes.rule: display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 5px; overflow: hidden;

classes.name: video-thumb
classes.rule: border-color: hsl(var(--accent) / 0.62);

classes.name: video-title
classes.rule: font-size: 1rem;

classes.name: visible
classes.rule: visibility: visible;

classes.name: visually-hidden
classes.rule: position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0); white-space: nowrap;
